Name: FaePup's Bog Styled Wedding Arch
Author: FungiFishy
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/prq7mXrV/ARCH.png[/img]
[b][i][font=Times New Roman][size=5]Have The Wedding of your most fantastical dreams beneath the blessing of the forest spirit![/size][/font]
[/i][/b]

﻿[i]With the blessing of the gracious and lovely [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch]BogWyytch[/url] , I have been giving the amazing chance to make a simple wedding arch replacement!

With this seasonal arch, you can now get married in bog style!

Please be sure to have the latest version of content patcher for this mod to work! remember, one can only have one replacer at a time, so if you are not seeing the arch in game, please ensure it is the only one in your mod folder!

Simply drag and drop into your mods folder, and you are done!

please enjoy, and give a big thanks to Bog for her lovely work!﻿[/i][/center]
